about_the_game:
Master the Art of Tactical Card Combat!

Enter a world where strategy meets skill in this intense single-player trading card experience!

Face off against 30 legendary Heroes in brutal card-to-card combat where every decision could mean victory or defeat. This isn't your typical card game – it's a chess match with devastating consequences.

⚔️ Revolutionary Combat System

Deploy your cards on a strategic 3x3 battlefield grid where positioning is everything. Master the ancient art of Triad Formation – combine cards from three unique groups to unleash devastating attacks and impenetrable defenses. With 8 valid triad combinations at your disposal, every battle offers countless tactical possibilities.

🎯 Intense Strategic Gameplay

  • Attack & Defend: Choose your three-card combinations wisely – your opponent will counter with equal fury

  • Resource Management: Every card matters when HP bars hover at 1000 points

  • Multiple Victory Conditions: Reduce your enemy to zero HP OR complete all 8 triads to claim victory

  • Progressive Rewards: Win battles to expand your collection – earn up to 3 cards per victory!

🏆 Challenge Awaits

Don't underestimate your opponents – these cunning Heroes fight with deadly intelligence and never surrender. They'll exploit every weakness and battle until their last breath. Victory requires more than luck; it demands tactical mastery.

Can you conquer all 30 Heroes and claim your place among legends?

✨ Features That Matter

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive mechanics that reveal deep strategic layers

  • Complete Single-Player Campaign: 30 unique opponents, each with their own fighting style

  • Achievement System: 10 challenging achievements for completionist gamers.

  • Cloud Save Support: Never lose your progress

  • Optimized Performance: Runs smoothly on low-spec systems

The battlefield awaits. Your cards are ready. Will you rise to become the ultimate tactician, or fall like countless warriors before you?

Prepare for battle – your legend starts now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible / Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
